title: Chunk a list
prompt: Read two lines from standard input. The first line is a comma-separated list of integers (it may be empty). The second line is a chunk size. Print a JSON array of chunks, each of at most that size, in order. Use console.log for the result and read input from stdin.

reference.notes: The empty-input case is the one most submissions fail: readline returns an empty string, not an empty array.

title: Normalise whitespace
prompt: Read one line from standard input and print it with every run of whitespace collapsed to a single space, leading and trailing whitespace removed, and nothing else changed. Preserve letter case and punctuation.
given:
Input
  a   b  c 

Output
a b c

reference.notes: str.split() with no argument is the whole problem; a regex is more code for the same result.
